findings.suggested_fix: Treat non-zero exits (especially 124/timeout) as unresolved: say the run produced no results, then re-run with a longer timeout or a narrowed target before drawing any conclusion about test health.

On to the summary." — the timeout was never acknowledged or re-run at that point (recorded as error_swallowing @ step 12).
